 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore

 (Aman Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Ot
 Dated : 15-04-2024
Shri Santosh Kumar Meena - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Bhuwan Gautam - Dy. Govt. Advocate for the respon
Heard on I.A. No.6140/2024, which is second application filed under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for grant of temporary suspension of jail sentence on behalf of appellant -Aman, S/o Vikram @ Santosh Anjana.
He suggested that the appellant may be permitted to take part in the last rites of his father in Police Custody subject to availability of sufficient force.
opennyai_summary.15_April_2024__facts:
Appellant stands convicted vide judgment dated 12.05.2023 passed by the learned First Additional Sessions Judge in Special Case No.25/2020 for offence under Section 366 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 05 years RI with fine of Rs. 2,000/- alongwith default stipulations and under Section 376(3) of the IPC and sentenced to undergo 20 years RI with fine of Rs. 4,000/- with default stipulations.
The unnatural death was registered at Police Station Pithampur, District Dhar.
The copy of the certificate of village Panchayat Sanghvi, Devpalpur, is filed to the effect that appellant/accused Aman is the only son of the deceased Vikram @ Santosh Anjana.
opennyai_summary.15_April_2024__arguments:
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the appellant has filed the application for grant of temporary suspension of jail sentence on the ground that his father died on 14.04.2024.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer for grant of temporary suspension of jail sentence.
opennyai_summary.15_April_2024__decision:
The appellant has prayed for suspension of jail sentence for a period of two months.
In view of the above, I.A.No.6140/2024 is partly allowed and the appellant is permitted to attend the last rites of his father in police custody subject to availability of sufficient Escort.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
This is first bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C, 1973) for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.269/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Manpur District-Indore for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC and under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 01.08.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that of commission of rape upon the prosecutrix.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
It is also submitted that the statements of the prosecutrix, who is a major lady as well has her parents have been recorded before the trial Court and she has not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The applicant is in custody since 01.08.2024.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
